title: Settings
languageHint: Display language of the app. Tag names are shown and edited in this language too.
comfyHint: ComfyUI Desktop and the standalone server use the same API. Check the port in ComfyUI's own settings (the server, usually 8188 or 8000). To reach ComfyUI on another machine, start it with listening on the network enabled.
preferredPort: Preferred port (applies after restart; a free one is used if taken)
savedDesktop: Saved. The ComfyUI address is in use now.
savedServer: Saved. The ComfyUI address is in use now; the Libretto port applies after a restart.
